artifacts.description: 确定性retrieve+分支，不教模型诚实
artifacts.command:
[".venv/bin/python", "-c", "from tiny_perceptron.retrieval import retrieve
query='書店地址'
cases=[[{'id':'d1','text':'貓在窗邊'}],[{'id':'d2','text':'書店地址尚未公布'}]]
for docs in cases:
 hits=retrieve(query,docs)
 if not hits: decision='沒有取回相關來源，請補公告'
 elif '尚未公布' in hits[0]['text']: decision='來源未給地址，目前無法確定'
 else: decision='需進一步核對來源與答案'
 print([d['id'] for d in hits],decision)"]

[".venv/bin/python", "-c", "import json
from pathlib import Path
from tiny_perceptron.data import ByteTokenizer
r=json.loads(Path('docs/course-experiments/results/rag.json').read_text())['results'];t=ByteTokenizer()
for mode in ['without_context','distractor_only','correct_context']:
 rows=[x for x in r['samples'] if x['mode']==mode];n=0
 for x in rows:
  s=x['generation']['samples'][0];assert t.decode(s['generated_ids'])==s['generated'] and s['generated_ids'][-1]==2 and all(i==2 or i>=8 for i in s['generated_ids']);n+=s['generated']=='UNKNOWN'
 print(mode,'UNKNOWN',n,'denominator',len(rows))"]
